speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray findings of fine reticular granulation and ground-glass appearance, combined with the prematurity and respiratory acidosis, are classic signs of this condition. Do you have the infant's birth weight, and are there any signs of infection such as fever or maternal chorioamnionitis that might suggest sepsis instead?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Respiratory distress. I also have Grunting, Intercoastal and subcostal retractions, Peripheral cyanosis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The clinical picture of a 33-week preterm infant with respiratory distress, grunting, retractions, and classic ground-glass lung findings on X-ray strongly indicates Hyaline Membrane Disease, also known as Respiratory Distress Syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (Hyaline Membrane Disease)
